paper.title: PEACE: A Planner-Executor Agent with Constraint Enforcement for UAVs
paper.central_claim: A planner-executor agent for PX4 drones (single-pass LLM MissionPlan of typed ROS 2/MAVLink tool calls, detector + pinhole-depth world model, altitude/geofence constraint enforcement, bounded replanning on tool failure) is feasible in PX4 SITL/Gazebo, and results highlight improved explainability, constraint enforcement and reduced LLM calls compared to tightly coupled LLM control.

evidence.quote: Results highlight improved explainability, constraint enforcement, and reduced LLM calls compared to tightly coupled LLM control.
evidence.support_explanation: Original comparative claim retained, not replaced by weaker feasibility-only target.

evidence.quote: TypeFly generates flight plans in a domain-specific language (MiniSpec) to reduce LLM inference latency
evidence.support_explanation: Closest lineage already amortizes planning; cannot accept blanket claim that fixed planning or reduced calls is new.

evidence.quote: a reasoning string followed by an ordered list of tool calls.
evidence.support_explanation: Typed MissionPlan separates planner construction from deterministic executor dispatch.

evidence.quote: a bounded replan is issued.
evidence.support_explanation: Executor re-invokes planner only after failure, not after every action; numerical cap not specified in release.

evidence.quote: using the synchronized depth image and camera intrinsics, and exposes an explicit depth-validity flag
evidence.support_explanation: Perception assumes metric calibrated depth; invalid flag is an explicit information-boundary mechanism, not robustness proof.

evidence.quote: Each planner invocation reads a consistent snapshot from both services
evidence.support_explanation: Grounding uses bounded timestamped state and world histories; snapshots can stale during nominal open-loop execution.

evidence.quote: Out-of-band altitude targets are clamped; geofence breaches abort the offending tool calls and surfaces a structured failure to the replanner.
evidence.support_explanation: Specific gate actions and physical scope. Altitude/geofence alone do not certify obstacle collision avoidance or full trajectory safety.

evidence.quote: The aim is not a quantitative benchmark, but to characterize the agent’s behavior
evidence.support_explanation: Explicit qualitative study; 108 prompts are not an empirical success denominator.

evidence.quote: takeoff and landing (12), relative motion (12), altitude and attitude control (12), waypoint navigation (13), geometric path following (13), object search and localization (12), open-vocabulary navigation (13), composite multi-step missions (13), and safety violation (8).
evidence.support_explanation: Prompt inventory totals108 but enumerates nine categories despite prose saying eight; not completed execution counts.

evidence.quote: takeoff(5) followed by forward(3)
evidence.support_explanation: Concrete nominal SITL trace, not per-task success rates or a baseline comparison.

evidence.quote: these are by design but propagate to the mission failure.
evidence.support_explanation: Gate rejects can be correct yet task fails; mission success cannot be substituted with safety-filter activation.

evidence.quote: the current open- loop planning assumption is brittle in such settings
evidence.support_explanation: Authors acknowledge dynamic-scene limitation; feedback only on tool failure does not handle all scene changes.

evidence.quote: The first is a sim-to-real deployment on physical UAV hardware.
evidence.support_explanation: Real transfer is future work, not evidence from this release.

evidence.quote: the adoption of a planner–executor paradigm reduces LLM invocations to a single call
evidence.support_explanation: Structural nominal call count; no measured call/latency/USD comparator and bounded replans can add calls.

evidence.quote: Results highlight improved explainability, constraint enforcement, and reduced LLM calls compared to tightly coupled LLM control.
evidence.support_explanation: 中心比较性主张：对“紧耦合 LLM 控制”改进三项。

evidence.quote: demonstrate its feasibility in PX4 software-in-the-loop simulations in Gazebo
evidence.support_explanation: 实际声称的证据层级：SITL 可行性演示。

evidence.quote: Planner–Executor agent in which an LLM generates a complete mission plan in a single pass as a sequence of structured tool calls, executed without further model intervention.
evidence.support_explanation: 贡献1：单次计划、结构化工具调用、执行期无模型介入。

evidence.quote: reduces LLM invocations to a single call, which is substantially lower than ReAct-based agents
evidence.support_explanation: “减少调用”为架构论断，无实测对照。

evidence.quote: re-invokes the LLM only on tool failure, in which case a bounded replan is issued
evidence.support_explanation: 重规划仅在工具失败时触发；界限数值未给。

evidence.quote: Removing the LLM from the fast control path eliminates an entire class of latency-induced and hallucination-induced failure modes
evidence.support_explanation: 设计论断，引用他人基准，未在本文测量。

evidence.quote: The aim is not a quantitative benchmark
evidence.support_explanation: 作者自述实验非定量基准。

evidence.quote: We compiled a set of 108 natural-language prompts spanning eight task categories
evidence.support_explanation: 108 条提示，8 类；无成功率/计数。

evidence.quote: safety violation (8)
evidence.support_explanation: 安全违规类仅 8 条提示；结果未报告。

evidence.quote: Across categories, four behavioral patterns are visible.
evidence.support_explanation: 仅定性行为模式。

evidence.quote: the planner emits a single MissionPlan comprising takeoff(5) followed by forward(3)
evidence.support_explanation: 唯一给出的具体示例。

evidence.quote: The mission logging makes each mission auditable offline.
evidence.support_explanation: 可审计性是日志属性，非测量结果。

evidence.quote: The preliminary results exhibit three recurring failure modes.
evidence.support_explanation: 失败模式：规划器错误/感知不确定/安全中止，无计数。

evidence.quote: extended runs of uncertain observations, collapse object search and navigation to degenerate plans
evidence.support_explanation: 感知不确定使搜索导航退化为空计划。

evidence.quote: these are by design but propagate to the mission failure
evidence.support_explanation: 安全中止“按设计”但传导为任务失败。

evidence.quote: Out-of-band altitude targets are clamped; geofence breaches abort the offending tool calls and surfaces a structured failure to the replanner.
evidence.support_explanation: 约束层：高度带钳制、围栏越界中止并回传结构化失败。

evidence.quote: Because the check is purely geometric, it is verifiable independently of the language model
evidence.support_explanation: 检查器为确定性几何，独立于 LLM。

evidence.quote: provides the construction required by the avoid-collision and regulatory-compliance axes of recent physical-safety benchmarks for LLM-controlled UAVs
evidence.support_explanation: 称满足避碰轴，但实现仅高度带+水平围栏。

evidence.quote: exposes an explicit depth-validity flag so the planner can distinguish confident localizations from uncertain ones
evidence.support_explanation: 深度有效性标记；深度度量/校准假设未述。

evidence.quote: a fast 2D object detector and a vision–language model generating structured detections
evidence.support_explanation: 两种可插拔感知后端，具体模型未指明。

evidence.quote: On replan, the user message is rebuilt from a fresh snapshot
evidence.support_explanation: 重规划用新快照重建上下文。

evidence.quote: the executor binds each tool directly to a MAVLink via ROS 2
evidence.support_explanation: 工具直接绑定 MAVLink/ROS 2。

evidence.quote: The action space is therefore fixed, inspectable
evidence.support_explanation: 固定、可检视的动作空间。

evidence.quote: TypeFly generates flight plans in a domain-specific language (MiniSpec) to reduce LLM inference latency
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻：同为降推理延迟的计划-执行路线。

evidence.quote: This design point is distinct from code-generating planners
evidence.support_explanation: 与代码生成式规划器的区分仅为文字陈述。

evidence.quote: the current open- loop planning assumption is brittle in such settings
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认开环单次规划在动态场景脆弱。

evidence.quote: idempotency at the tool layer is required
evidence.support_explanation: 工具层状态机交互问题。

evidence.quote: Metric tasks (waypoint, relative motion, altitude control) admit the most reliable plans
evidence.support_explanation: 定性陈述，无数字。

evidence.quote: an off-the-shelf LLM is sufficient for the planner
evidence.support_explanation: 称现成 LLM 足够；未指明模型。

evidence.quote: The first is a sim-to-real deployment on physical UAV hardware.
evidence.support_explanation: 真机部署为未来工作。

evidence.quote: Object-referential prompts are restricted to the vocabulary
evidence.support_explanation: 物体指称限于 5 个类别。

evidence.quote: Out-of-band altitude targets are clamped
evidence.support_explanation: Altitude violations are clamped (command modified); only geofence breaches are stated to surface a structured failure.

Inference: a clamped altitude target changes the executed motion without a stated failure message to the planner, so the planner's plan and the realized motion can diverge silently (observe_act_interface F2 'requested rather than realized motion').

evidence.quote: enforcing two geometric constraints: an altitude band and a horizontal geofence around the takeoff point
evidence.support_explanation: The checker covers only altitude and a takeoff-centred geofence; no obstacle model, so the avoid-collision axis claim is not met by construction.

signatures.object: PX4/Gazebo UAV planner–executor control path, replacing per-action LLM reasoning with fixed MissionPlan
signatures.information: Natural-language task, static tool/rule/schema prompt, timestamped bounded robot/world histories; world objects projected from 2D detections using synchronized metric depth and intrinsics in ENU; actual LLM ID and detailed schemas absent.
signatures.operation: One planner invocation emits reasoning plus ordered calls; ROS2 executor binds to MAVLink and executes sequentially; fresh state snapshot and bounded replan on tool failure.
signatures.output: Inspectable fixed tool sequence, per-step records and final state; no generated arbitrary executable policy.
signatures.conditions: Known fixed tool vocabulary, accurate state/arming preconditions, sufficiently static scene and valid depth calibration.
signatures.feedback: Typed execution failure, invalid depth/world detections and gate abort; no continuous model-level reconsideration in successful nominal tool sequence.
signatures.selection_rule: Static deterministic schema and geometry validation, not optimized retained artifact selection.
signatures.selection_data: Per-call requested motion and current flight state against configured limits; numerical caps not stated.
signatures.persistence: Fixed tool/schema/context services and mission logs; no learned policy or persistent harness modification reported.
signatures.later_use: Mission dispatch in qualitative SITL prompts; logs suggested for future distillation, which is not implemented evidence.
signatures.claimed_effect: Explainable plans with fewer LLM calls and externally constrained flight.
signatures.failure_boundary: Undetected tool/scene changes cascade; perception degeneracy and arming/offboard idempotency errors; exact model/limits/retry policy insufficiently specified.

signatures.object: Independent altitude and horizontal-geofence motion gate
signatures.information: Requested target altitude, horizontal target and takeoff-centered geofence; geometric, not LLM confidence.
signatures.operation: Clamp altitude out of band; abort geofence breach; return structured failure for bounded planner recovery.
signatures.output: Only accepted/clamped target motion commands reach low-level controller.
signatures.conditions: Geometry and frame conventions correct; point/target check scope, trajectory sweep and control tracking not demonstrated.
signatures.feedback: Safety-validation abort distinct from task success.
signatures.selection_rule: Configured altitude band and horizontal radius; numerical values not supplied.
signatures.selection_data: Per-call command values, not training data or selected test outcomes.
signatures.later_use: Applies to each emitted motion command; qualitative safety prompts described.
signatures.claimed_effect: Constraints enforced independently of planner mistakes.
signatures.failure_boundary: Does not establish obstacle avoidance, dynamics-aware continuous constraint satisfaction or regulatory compliance.

gap.author_gap: Tight per-tool LLM loops add latency and expose hallucinated commands; end-to-end policies are opaque, hard to constrain and data-dependent.
gap.checked_gap: Plausible engineering motivation; no measurement of neighbours' residual problems or of this system's effect. TypeFly already compiles flight plans to reduce latency.

gap.residue: Fixed inspectable action schema plus an LLM-independent command gate and failure-only replanning in a PX4/ROS 2 stack.
gap.stakes: Physical harm from hallucinated/ill-typed UAV commands.
gap.method_response: Single typed plan, deterministic dispatch, geometric gate, bounded replan.
gap.remaining_gap: All comparative effects unmeasured; collision avoidance not covered; dynamic scenes and real hardware future work.
unresolved: Nearest-neighbour originals not supplied; no novelty verdict.

assessment.evidence_level_reason: Both seats: SITL interaction but only a qualitative demonstration and one logged example; no environment-judged success counts.
assessment.author_claim_kept: Results highlight improved explainability, constraint enforcement, and reduced LLM calls compared to tightly coupled LLM control.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: The paper describes a single-pass typed planner-executor UAV agent with an LLM-independent altitude/geofence gate and failure-only replanning, implemented in PX4 SITL and illustrated with one logged mission and qualitative behaviour over 108 prompts. None of the comparative improvements is measured, and the gate does not cover collisions despite the stated avoid-collision axis.
cannot_conclude: Any improvement over tightly coupled LLM control.
Measured reduction of calls or latency.

G.reason: Both seats 2; confirmed. Real engineering bottlenecks (per-tool LLM latency, unaudited actions, data dependence) motivated by cited surveys/benchmarks; closest neighbour TypeFly already amortizes planning, and the difference (typed MissionPlan + independent gate) is stated, not measured; no residual measured in neighbours.

M.reason: son55 value adopted (sol 3). Single-pass typed plan + deterministic executor addresses latency/auditability, but: the independent gate is orthogonal to the planner-executor paradigm and is justified as satisfying the avoid-collision axis while checking only altitude and a geofence (agg:C03, son55:E018); open-loop single-pass planning conflicts with the stated perception uncertainty and is handled only at tool-failure granularity (authors' own failure modes); clamping silently alters commands (agg:C02). Concrete mechanism with weak key assumptions = anchor 2.

X.reason: Both seats 2; confirmed. Data flow, two-message prompt assembly, snapshot rebuild on replan, clamp vs abort semantics and pluggable perception are described; planner LLM, detector models, tool schema, numeric altitude/geofence bounds, replan cap and depth-validity rule are not given.
